3 Open Source Alternatives to Trello

Kanban-style visual task management and collaboration tool. Replace Trello with free, transparent, and community-driven self-hostable software.

Official Trello Site ↗
#1

AFFiNE

Productivity & Notes
★ 74,100 Stars

Next-gen workspace merging docs, whiteboards, and relational tables

AFFiNE combines docs, infinite whiteboards, and multi-dimensional tables into a unified block-based environment. Privacy-focused with full peer-to-peer and self-hosting options.

Key Open Source Features:

  • ✓ Seamless switch between Document mode and Whiteboard canvas
  • ✓ Local-first architecture with real-time CRDT sync
  • ✓ Extensible plugin system and Markdown export
  • ✓ True MIT open-source license
License: MIT Stack: TypeScript, Rust

#2

Focalboard

Project Management
★ 26,800 Stars

Self-hosted project and task management for technical teams

Focalboard (by Mattermost) is a multilingual, open-source project management solution that replaces Trello, Notion, and Asana with clean Kanban and table boards.

Key Open Source Features:

  • ✓ Kanban, table, calendar, and gallery card layouts
  • ✓ Single-binary standalone install or Docker deployment
  • ✓ Deep integration with Mattermost team chats
  • ✓ Unlimited board filtering, properties, and templates
License: MIT Stack: Go, TypeScript, React

#3

Planka

Project Management
★ 12,800 Stars

Real-time collaborative Kanban board for workgroups

Planka is a sleek, lightweight Kanban board alternative to Trello. Supports projects, multiple boards, lists, cards, attachments, checklists, and real-time updates.

Key Open Source Features:

  • ✓ Real-time team collaboration with WebSocket synchronization
  • ✓ Custom card labels, deadlines, and markdown descriptions
  • ✓ OIDC / Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication support
  • ✓ Ultra-lightweight Docker container setup
License: AGPL-3.0 Stack: JavaScript, React, Node.js
